verdicts.rationale: pdfurl inserts its argument directly into the URI literal without calling txiescapepdf, and urefbreakfinish passes the URL unchanged. The active-character setup does not escape parentheses, so a URL containing an unmatched literal parenthesis can break the PDF string.

verdicts.rationale: Latin character definitions globally replace active lead bytes, including C2 and C3 at L8949-L8950, but the UTF-8 selection only sets catcodes and installs Unicode lookup mappings. The byte-decoder installation at L9163-L9193 executes once during loading and is not rerun when switching back to UTF-8.

UTFviiiLoop increments the byte and recurses only while it is strictly below countUTFy, so this initialization covers F0 through F3 and excludes F4. No later decoder assignment supplies F4, leaving valid F4-prefixed sequences undecoded.

utfeightchardefs contains no mappings for U+00B1, U+00B5, U+00D7, or U+00F7, although latonechardefs renders their Latin-1 bytes with math symbols. For these undefined UTF-8 lookups, UTFviiiDefined emits only a message and no replacement glyph.

verdicts.rationale: U+0162 is assigned a lowercase t and U+0163 an uppercase T, reversing the required cases. The cedilla helper preserves its argument case, so it does not neutralize the swapped mappings.
The U+2192 mapping selects expansion, which is explicitly defined as mapsto at L3017. The distinct arrow macro at L3015 renders rightarrow, so the Unicode rightwards arrow receives the wrong symbol.
